messages:
maria: Quick sync — proposing a large-scale load + soak test this Fri to validate runtime perf and catch regressions. Plan: k6/Locust traffic replay against /v1/generate, 30m prefix replay to warm KV cache, then 6h soak at steady ~2.5k TPS with a 15m spike to 5k. Need infra reservation, SRE coverage, and an approvals stamp. Thoughts?

ajay: Sounds good. Can we scope to two model variants: quantized (cheap) and fp16 (baseline)? Route to quantized first, then failover to fp16 so we observe fallback behavior and perf delta. Also capture model fallback logs.

taylor: I can reserve staging cluster. What machine types and total GPUs do you need? I need a runbook + alert thresholds before we start (OOM, GPU temp, p95 latency). I can create an incident ticket for the soak window.

kevin: +1 on capture requirements. We'll want metrics: p50/p95/p99 token latency, GPU util (SM%), GPU memory, batch-size distribution, KV cache hit rate, and model inference error rate. Also collect router & proxy latencies.

olga: For KV cache warmup please use traffic replay from real prefixes (sanitized) — that gives realistic cache behavior. Also include a small sample of long-context sessions to exercise KV eviction.

maria: Good notes. Tentative infra ask: 8 nodes with 8xA100-equivalent GPUs (or 64 smaller GPUs) to reach target throughput; can reduce if autoscaling is allowed. @taylor can you confirm capacity?

taylor: I can provision 8 nodes A100-eq for the window. We'll reserve a separate VPC to avoid noisy neighbors. I need a smoke plan: ramp profile, canary checks, and an emergency stop.

ajay: Smoke plan: 1) replay warmup 30m at 300 TPS; 2) ramp to 500 TPS for 10m; 3) ramp to 2.5k over 20m; 4) soak 6h; 5) spike to 5k for 15m at hour 3. Use auth header for test key and limit to /v1/generate only. Disable autoscaler during soak to observe saturation.

kevin: Example k6 command for synthetic: 
```
k6 run --vus 2500 --duration 6h00m script_generate.js --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086
```
and for replay tool (prod logs -> replay):
```
./tools/traffic-replay -source s3://replay-buckets/2026-03-10-prefixes.tar.gz -rate 2500 -target https://staging.redwood/api/v1/replay -concurrency 500
```
Collect extra labels: model_variant, seq_len_bucket, client_id_hash.

maria: Nice. We'll also add locust for a user-session style test to validate long-lived connections and KV eviction. Locust config will simulate 10k users with realistic think times but low token rates per user.

olga: Reminder: include sequence-length distribution check before the soak to ensure we mirror prod distribution. I'll share a small dataset of sequence-length histograms.

ajay: One more: watch for token truncation and dropped completions when queue delays spike. Add alert if completion rate < 98% over 5m.

ci-bot: ci-bot: linked PR #389: perf/k6: add generative load test scripts and replay config (draft).

sre-bot: sre-bot: incident PERF-2026-04 created for planned soak; on-call rotation updated, paging enabled for GPU OOM and p99 latency breach.

kevin: I can run a 30m dry-run tomorrow at 200 TPS to validate scripts and collection. Will post results.

maria: Excellent. Proposed window: Fri 10:00–16:00 UTC (includes warmup + soak). @taylor can you take 10:00–13:00 coverage and @kevin 13:00–16:00?

taylor: I can take 10:00–13:00. Will draft runbook and add alert thresholds.

kevin: I can cover 13:00–16:00. I'll monitor GPUs and model errors.

maria: Checklist before go: 1) infra reserved (taylor) 2) PR with k6/locust & replay artifact (maria/ci) 3) dry-run & smoke (kevin) 4) runbook + alerts (taylor) 5) traces & seq-length baselines attached (olga) 6) on-call coverage confirmed.

ajay: Add: collect fallback logs & eviction events + save full request traces for any p95/regression alerts.

olga: I'll upload baseline traces to the perf bucket and link in the PR.

maria: Thanks all — locking Fri 10–16 UTC. Please ack here once you have your tasks queued. :thumbsup:

ajay: ack

taylor: ack

kevin: ack — I'll post dry-run results tomorrow.

maria: Great — I'll follow up with PR link and runbook in this thread. Thanks!
